# Documentação de Arquitetura C4 – Push Notification Manager

## Introdução

Este documento apresenta a arquitetura do sistema **Push Notification Manager** utilizando o modelo C4 (Context, Containers, Components, Code). Os diagramas foram gerados com PlantUML e a biblioteca C4-PlantUML.

O sistema permite o gerenciamento de notificações push, incluindo cadastro de dispositivos e envio de notificações via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM).

---

## Nível 1 – Diagrama de Contexto

O diagrama de contexto mostra o sistema Push Notification Manager e suas interações com atores externos e sistemas externos.

```plantuml
@startuml c4_nivel1_contexto
!include https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML/master/C4_Context.puml

title Nível 1 - Diagrama de Contexto do Sistema

Person(admin, "Administrador", "Gerencia dispositivos e envio de notificações push")
Person(endUser, "Usuário Final", "Recebe notificações push no dispositivo móvel")

System(pushSystem, "Push Notification Manager", "Sistema de gerenciamento de notificações push. Permite cadastrar dispositivos e enviar notificações via FCM.")

System_Ext(firebase, "Firebase Cloud Messaging", "Serviço de push da Google para entrega de mensagens aos dispositivos móveis")

Rel(admin, pushSystem, "Gerencia dispositivos e notificações", "HTTPS")
Rel(pushSystem, firebase, "Envia notificações push", "HTTPS/REST")
Rel(firebase, endUser, "Entrega notificação", "Push Protocol")

SHOW_LEGEND()
@enduml
```

## Nível 2 – Diagrama de Contêineres

O diagrama de contêineres detalha os componentes internos do sistema: Frontend UI, Backend API, Device Service, Notification Service, RabbitMQ e os bancos de dados PostgreSQL.

```plantuml
@startuml c4_nivel2_containers
!include https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML/master/C4_Container.puml

title Nível 2 - Diagrama de Contêineres

Person(admin, "Administrador", "Gerencia dispositivos e notificações")

System_Boundary(pushSystem, "Push Notification Manager") {
    Container(frontend, "Frontend UI", "React / Webpack Dev Server", "Interface web SPA para administração. Porta 9060")
    Container(backend, "Backend API", "Spring Boot / Java 21", "Autenticação JWT, gerenciamento de usuários e proxy para microsserviços. Porta 8080")
    Container(deviceMs, "Device Service", "Spring Boot / Java 21", "Gerencia cadastro e consulta de dispositivos. Porta 8081")
    Container(notificationMs, "Notification Service", "Spring Boot / Java 21", "Orquestra envio de notificações push via FCM. Porta 8082")
    ContainerQueue(rabbitmq, "RabbitMQ", "AMQP 0.9.1", "Message broker para comunicação assíncrona entre microsserviços. Porta 5672")
    ContainerDb(monolithDb, "Monolith DB", "PostgreSQL 16", "Armazena usuários, authorities e dados de autenticação. Porta 5432")
    ContainerDb(deviceDb, "Device DB", "PostgreSQL 16", "Armazena dispositivos registrados. Porta 5434")
    ContainerDb(notificationDb, "Notification DB", "PostgreSQL 16", "Armazena histórico de notificações enviadas. Porta 5433")
}

System_Ext(firebase, "Firebase Cloud Messaging", "Serviço de push da Google")

Rel(admin, frontend, "Acessa interface web", "HTTPS")
Rel(frontend, backend, "Chamadas REST", "HTTP/JSON")
Rel(backend, monolithDb, "Lê/Escreve dados de usuário", "JDBC")
Rel(backend, deviceMs, "Consulta/Registra dispositivos", "HTTP/REST")
Rel(backend, notificationMs, "Solicita envio de notificações", "HTTP/REST")
Rel(deviceMs, deviceDb, "Lê/Escreve dispositivos", "JDBC")
Rel(deviceMs, rabbitmq, "Publica DeviceRegisteredEvent", "AMQP")
Rel(notificationMs, notificationDb, "Lê/Escreve notificações", "JDBC")
Rel(notificationMs, rabbitmq, "Consome eventos de dispositivo", "AMQP")
Rel(notificationMs, firebase, "Envia mensagem push", "HTTPS/REST")

SHOW_LEGEND()
@enduml
```

## Nível 3 – Componentes do Notification Service

Este diagrama detalha os componentes do Notification Service seguindo a Arquitetura Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters), incluindo use cases, ports e adapters.

```plantuml
@startuml c4_nivel3_notification
!include https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML/master/C4_Component.puml

title Nível 3 - Componentes do Notification Service (Arquitetura Hexagonal)

Container_Boundary(notificationMs, "Notification Service (Spring Boot)") {
    Component(notifController, "NotificationController", "REST Adapter (Inbound)", "Endpoints REST para envio e consulta de notificações.")
    Component(restExHandler, "RestExceptionHandler", "ControllerAdvice", "Tratamento global de exceções REST.")

    Component(sendUseCase, "SendPushNotificationUseCase", "Use Case", "Orquestra envio de push: persiste, envia via FCM, atualiza status.")
    Component(getByIdUseCase, "GetNotificationByIdUseCase", "Use Case", "Busca notificação por ID.")
    Component(getHistoryUseCase, "GetNotificationHistoryUseCase", "Use Case", "Lista histórico com filtros.")
    Component(markDeliveredUseCase, "MarkNotificationDeliveredUseCase", "Use Case", "Marca notificação como entregue (ACK do FCM).")

    Component(repoPort, "NotificationRepositoryPort", "Port (Outbound)", "Interface de persistência de notificações.")
    Component(pushSenderPort, "PushSenderPort", "Port (Outbound)", "Interface de envio push (FCM).")
    Component(eventPublisherPort, "NotificationEventPublisherPort", "Port (Outbound)", "Interface de publicação de eventos.")

    Component(repoAdapter, "NotificationRepositoryAdapter", "Persistence Adapter", "Implementa repositório com Spring Data JPA.")
    Component(jpaRepo, "NotificationJpaRepository", "Spring Data JPA", "Interface JPA para NotificationJpaEntity.")
    Component(fcmService, "FcmService", "FCM Adapter (Outbound)", "Integra com Firebase Admin SDK para envio de push.")
    Component(rabbitPublisher, "RabbitNotificationEventPublisher", "Messaging Adapter (Outbound)", "Publica eventos de falha no RabbitMQ.")

    Component(deviceConsumer, "DeviceRegisteredConsumer", "Messaging Adapter (Inbound)", "Consome DeviceRegisteredEvent do RabbitMQ.")
    Component(retryConsumer, "NotificationRetryConsumer", "Messaging Adapter (Inbound)", "Consome eventos de retry para reenvio.")

    Component(secConfig, "SecurityConfiguration", "Config", "Segurança JWT para proteger endpoints.")
    Component(rabbitConfig, "RabbitMQConfig", "Config", "Configuração de filas, exchanges e bindings.")
    Component(firebaseConfig, "FirebaseConfig", "Config", "Inicializa FirebaseApp com service account.")
}

ContainerDb(notifDb, "Notification DB", "PostgreSQL 16", "Histórico de notificações")
ContainerQueue(rabbitmq, "RabbitMQ", "AMQP", "Eventos de dispositivo e retry")
System_Ext(firebase, "Firebase Cloud Messaging", "Push delivery")

Rel(notifController, sendUseCase, "Invoca envio")
Rel(notifController, getByIdUseCase, "Consulta por ID")
Rel(notifController, getHistoryUseCase, "Lista histórico")
Rel(notifController, markDeliveredUseCase, "Confirma entrega")
Rel(sendUseCase, repoPort, "Persiste notificação")
Rel(sendUseCase, pushSenderPort, "Envia push")
Rel(sendUseCase, eventPublisherPort, "Publica evento de falha")
Rel(repoPort, repoAdapter, "Implementado por")
Rel(repoAdapter, jpaRepo, "Delega para JPA")
Rel(jpaRepo, notifDb, "JDBC")
Rel(pushSenderPort, fcmService, "Implementado por")
Rel(fcmService, firebase, "HTTPS/REST")
Rel(eventPublisherPort, rabbitPublisher, "Implementado por")
Rel(rabbitPublisher, rabbitmq, "AMQP")
Rel(deviceConsumer, rabbitmq, "Consome", "DeviceRegisteredEvent")
Rel(retryConsumer, rabbitmq, "Consome", "SendNotificationFailedEvent")
Rel(deviceConsumer, sendUseCase, "Dispara envio para novo dispositivo")

@enduml
```

## Nível 4 – Diagrama de Classes: Módulo de Autenticação

Este diagrama de classes detalha o módulo de autenticação do monolith-ui, incluindo o fluxo JWT, UserDetailsService, repositórios e padrões de projeto utilizados.

```plantuml
@startuml c4_nivel4_auth
title Nível 4 - Diagrama de Classes: Módulo de Autenticação (monolith-ui)

skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

package "web.rest" {
    class AuthenticateController {
        - authenticationManagerBuilder: AuthenticationManagerBuilder
        - tokenProvider: JwtEncoder
        + authorize(loginVM: LoginVM): ResponseEntity<JWTToken>
    }
    class AccountResource {
        - userService: UserService
        + registerAccount(managedUserVM: ManagedUserVM): void
        + getAccount(): AdminUserDTO
        + activateAccount(key: String): void
    }
    class LoginVM {
        - username: String
        - password: String
        - rememberMe: Boolean
    }
}

package "security" {
    class SecurityConfiguration <<@Configuration>> {
        + filterChain(http: HttpSecurity): SecurityFilterChain
    }
    class SecurityJwtConfiguration <<@Configuration>> {
        - jwtKey: String
        + jwtDecoder(): JwtDecoder
        + jwtEncoder(): JwtEncoder
    }
    class DomainUserDetailsService <<@Service>> {
        - userRepository: UserRepository
        + loadUserByUsername(login: String): UserDetails
    }
    class SecurityUtils {
        + {static} getCurrentUserLogin(): Optional<String>
        + {static} isAuthenticated(): boolean
    }
}

package "service" {
    class UserService <<@Service>> {
        - userRepository: UserRepository
        - authorityRepository: AuthorityRepository
        - passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder
        + createUser(dto: AdminUserDTO): User
        + updateUser(dto: AdminUserDTO): Optional<AdminUserDTO>
        + deleteUser(login: String): void
        + getUserWithAuthorities(): Optional<User>
    }
    class UserMapper <<MapStruct>> {
        + userToUserDTO(user: User): UserDTO
        + userToAdminUserDTO(user: User): AdminUserDTO
    }
}

package "service.dto" {
    class AdminUserDTO {
        - id: Long
        - login: String
        - email: String
        - authorities: Set<String>
    }
}

package "model" {
    class User <<@Entity>> {
        - id: Long
        - login: String
        - passwordHash: String
        - email: String
        - activated: Boolean
        - authorities: Set<Authority>
    }
    class Authority <<@Entity>> {
        - name: String
    }
    abstract class AbstractAuditingEntity {
        - createdBy: String
        - createdDate: Instant
        - lastModifiedBy: String
        - lastModifiedDate: Instant
    }
}

package "repository" {
    interface UserRepository <<JpaRepository>> {
        + findOneByLogin(login: String): Optional<User>
        + findOneByEmailIgnoreCase(email: String): Optional<User>
    }
    interface AuthorityRepository <<JpaRepository>> {
        + findById(name: String): Optional<Authority>
    }
}

User --|> AbstractAuditingEntity
User "*" -- "*" Authority

AuthenticateController --> SecurityJwtConfiguration : usa encoder
AuthenticateController --> DomainUserDetailsService : autentica
AccountResource --> UserService
UserService --> UserRepository
UserService --> AuthorityRepository
UserService --> UserMapper
DomainUserDetailsService --> UserRepository
UserMapper --> AdminUserDTO
UserRepository --> User
AuthorityRepository --> Authority

note right of SecurityConfiguration
  Padrões: Chain of Responsibility (filtros),
  Strategy (autenticação JWT vs session)
end note

note right of UserService
  Padrões: Facade (orquestra repos),
  DTO (transferência de dados),
  Singleton (Spring Bean)
end note
@enduml
```

## Nível 4 – Diagrama de Classes: Comunicação Assíncrona

Este diagrama de classes detalha a comunicação assíncrona (Event-Driven) entre o Device Service e o Notification Service via RabbitMQ, incluindo eventos, publishers e consumers.

```plantuml
@startuml c4_nivel4_async
title Nível 4 - Diagrama de Classes: Comunicação Assíncrona (Event-Driven)

skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

package "device-ms" {
    package "domain" as deviceDomain {
        class Device <<@Entity>> {
            - id: UUID
            - ownerLogin: String
            - fcmToken: FcmToken
            - deviceType: DeviceType
            - status: DeviceStatus
        }
        class FcmToken <<Value Object>> {
            - value: String
        }
        enum DeviceType {
            ANDROID
            IOS
            WEB
        }
        enum DeviceStatus {
            ACTIVE
            INACTIVE
        }
    }

    package "port" as devicePort {
        interface DeviceEventPublisherPort <<Port>> {
            + publishDeviceRegistered(device: Device): void
        }
        interface DeviceRepositoryPort <<Port>> {
            + save(device: Device): Device
            + findByFcmToken(token: FcmToken): Optional<Device>
            + findAllByOwnerLogin(login: String): List<Device>
        }
    }

    package "usecase" as deviceUseCase {
        class RegisterDeviceUseCase <<@Service>> {
            - repositoryPort: DeviceRepositoryPort
            - eventPublisherPort: DeviceEventPublisherPort
            + execute(command: RegisterDeviceCommand): Device
        }
        class RegisterDeviceCommand {
            - ownerLogin: String
            - fcmToken: String
            - deviceType: DeviceType
        }
    }

    package "adapter.messaging" as deviceMessaging {
        class RabbitDeviceEventPublisher <<@Component>> {
            - rabbitTemplate: RabbitTemplate
            + publishDeviceRegistered(device: Device): void
        }
        class DeviceRegisteredEvent <<Event DTO>> {
            - deviceId: UUID
            - ownerLogin: String
            - fcmToken: String
            - deviceType: String
            - registeredAt: Instant
        }
    }
}

package "notification-ms" {
    package "adapter.messaging" as notifMessaging {
        class DeviceRegisteredConsumer <<@Component>> {
            - sendPushUseCase: SendPushNotificationUseCase
            + onDeviceRegistered(event: DeviceRegisteredEvent): void
        }
        class NotifDeviceRegisteredEvent <<Event DTO>> {
            - deviceId: UUID
            - ownerLogin: String
            - fcmToken: String
            - deviceType: String
            - registeredAt: Instant
        }
        class NotificationRetryConsumer <<@Component>> {
            - sendPushUseCase: SendPushNotificationUseCase
            + onRetry(event: SendNotificationFailedEvent): void
        }
    }

    package "usecase" as notifUseCase {
        class SendPushNotificationUseCase <<@Service>> {
            - repoPort: NotificationRepositoryPort
            - pushSenderPort: PushSenderPort
            - eventPublisherPort: NotificationEventPublisherPort
            + execute(command: SendPushNotificationCommand): PushNotification
        }
    }
}

package "Infrastructure" {
    class rabbit <<Message Broker>> {
        Exchange: device.events (topic)
        Queue: notification.device.registered
        Routing Key: device.registered
        DLQ: notification.retry
    }
}

' Relationships
RegisterDeviceUseCase --> DeviceEventPublisherPort : usa
DeviceEventPublisherPort <|.. RabbitDeviceEventPublisher : implements
RabbitDeviceEventPublisher --> rabbit : publica DeviceRegisteredEvent
rabbit --> DeviceRegisteredConsumer : consome DeviceRegisteredEvent
rabbit --> NotificationRetryConsumer : consome retry events
DeviceRegisteredConsumer --> SendPushNotificationUseCase : dispara envio
RegisterDeviceUseCase --> DeviceRepositoryPort : persiste

note bottom of RabbitDeviceEventPublisher
  Padrões:
  - Publisher/Subscriber
  - Event-Driven Architecture
  - Ports & Adapters (Hexagonal)
end note

note bottom of DeviceRegisteredConsumer
  @RabbitListener anotação Spring
  Desacoplamento total entre
  producer e consumer
end note
@enduml
```

## Instruções para Regeneração dos Diagramas

Para regenerar as imagens a partir dos arquivos `.puml`:

```bash
cd /home/vitor.maverick/lab/docs/c4
java -Xmx1024m -jar plantuml.jar -tpng -o ./img c4_nivel1_contexto.puml
java -Xmx1024m -jar plantuml.jar -tpng -o ./img c4_nivel2_containers.puml
java -Xmx1024m -jar plantuml.jar -tpng -o ./img c4_nivel3_monolith.puml
java -Xmx1024m -jar plantuml.jar -tpng -o ./img c4_nivel3_notification.puml
java -Xmx1024m -jar plantuml.jar -tpng -o ./img c4_nivel4_auth.puml
java -Xmx1024m -jar plantuml.jar -tpng -o ./img c4_nivel4_async.puml
```

**Requisitos:**
- Java 11+ instalado
- Graphviz instalado (`apt install graphviz`)
- `plantuml.jar` presente no diretório
